'''Sado-machinists''' are found on [[Bloodsplatter Isle]] during the [[A Clockwork Syringe]]. They are minions of [[Mi-Gor]], and are called to do his bidding near the end of the quest when the player reaches the room with the conveyor belts and lever.

When they start climbing onto the conveyor belt and walk towards the player, using a [[Bundle o' kegs|keg]] will blast them away, leaving an open space to put down another keg to blast the conveyor belt machine to chase Mi-Gor.
